open KdVPlan in let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k;
 ∀ f, Reg f → Reg (fun t=>S t (f t))
proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  intro f hf n
  obtain ⟨ev,he,hsep⟩:=@yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  let φ : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ:=fun k t=>(k:ℂ)^n*S t (f t) k
  have hφ : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (φ k):=by
    intro k
    exact contDiff_const.mul ((@yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 k).1.mul
      ((@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 f hf k))
  have hh : ∀ j i : ℕ, ∃ w : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2, Continuous w ∧
      ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (w t) k= S t (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)^(n+3*i)*iteratedDeriv (j-i) (fun r=>f r k) t) k:=by
    intro j i
    obtain ⟨u,hu,huE⟩:=(@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 f hf (j-i) (n+3*i)
    have huEq : ∀ t, FromLP 1 (u t)=(fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)^(n+3*i)*iteratedDeriv (j-i) (fun r=>f r k) t):=fun t=>funext (huE t)
    obtain ⟨w,hw,hwE⟩:=@yui_aux_0061 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ ⟨u,hu.continuous,huEq⟩
    exact ⟨w,hw,fun t k=>congrFun (hwE t) k⟩
  choose w hw hwE using hh
  let U : ℕ → ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2 :=
    fun j t=>∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j+1), ((j.choose i:ℂ)*Complex.I^i) • w j i t
  have hU : ∀ j, Continuous (U j):=by
    intro j
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i hi=>continuous_const.smul (hw j i))
  have hUE : ∀ j k t, ev k (U j t)=iteratedDeriv j (φ k) t:=by
    intro j k t
    change ev k (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j+1), ((j.choose i:ℂ)*Complex.I^i) • w j i t)=_
    simp only [map_sum]
    have hscalar : ∀ (c : ℂ) (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2), ev k (c • x)=c*ev k x:=by
      intro c x
      rw [he,(@yui_aux_0046 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.1,he]
      rfl
    simp_rw [hscalar,he,hwE]
    change _ = iteratedDeriv j (fun r=>(k:ℂ)^n*(Complex.exp (Complex.I*(r*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ))*f r k)) t
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_mul
      ((@yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 k).1.of_le (le_of_lt (@yui_aux_0052 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 j))).contDiffAt
      (((@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 f hf k).of_le (le_of_lt (@yui_aux_0052 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 j))).contDiffAt]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [(@yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 k).2]
    simp only [S,pow_add,mul_pow,pow_mul]
    ring
  have hUs : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (U 0):=
    @yui_aux_0053 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ _ _ ℤ ev hsep φ hφ U hU hUE
  refine ⟨U 0,hUs,?_⟩
  intro t k
  rw [← he,hUE]
  rfl)
